resolution_2026_10_27.why: the publisher's site refused automated access (HTTP 403); getting around it was not attempted
resolution_2026_10_27.decision: The disputed median is dropped from CITERIFT's claims: neither 3.68 nor 5.8 years is used as a fact. The arXiv v3 full text says 3.68 years (1,344 days) throughout; the published version's Crossref abstract says 5.8 years (2,106 days); which the published full text reports is not established.
resolution_2026_10_27.how_to_settle: anyone can open the open-access ACM PDF in a browser and read the median from the published text
